summary: E2E testing of Roles (jabatan) CMS module. Backend: 12/12 pytest tests passed covering CRUD, uniqueness (409), parent validation (400), cycle prevention (self + descendant), PUT exclude_unset semantics, null-parent, delete promotion, bulk-delete with orphan promotion to nearest surviving ancestor. Frontend: full flow verified via Playwright - login, /roles renders inside Card, Add Role dialog with name+parent select, tree-indented Name column with chevron, Direct superior column, and 'Superiors (top ↑)' chain rendered nearest-first joined by '›'. Edit dialog correctly EXCLUDES self and all descendants from parent Select. Delete shows RED destructive confirm; children promoted to grandparent. Bulk delete with red confirm works and promotes orphans. Offices regression (list/navigation) still works.
critical_code_review_comments: RolesPage.jsx: NONE sentinel value ('__none__') used with React Hook Form for Select — works but adds a small mental overhead; consider mapping in the resolver instead. Non-blocking.
buildTree() sorts alphabetically by name at each level — deterministic and fine, but there is no explicit 'sort by creation' option; acceptable given schema (no sort_order field).
Backend _validate_parent walks ancestors on every PUT — O(depth). Fine for realistic org sizes.

roles unique index on name is created on startup; if a duplicate already exists at startup index creation will raise. Not an issue currently but worth guarding with try/except if the collection ever contains dupes.
test_credentials: Frontend mock: user@example.com / password (Sign In). Backend: no auth.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Direktur, TEST_KepalaBagian, TEST_AODana during E2E and cleaned them up via bulk-delete. Backend fixture also cleans up TEST_* on teardown. Pre-existing manual roles (Direktur, Kepala Bagian Pendanaan, AO Dana) left untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Roles module fully E2E verified. Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_roles.py can be re-run for regressions. Note: `roles-edit-<id>` and `roles-delete-<id>` are inside a DropdownMenu — must click `roles-row-actions-<id>` first, then click the menu item with force=True.
